name: Atticus
price_note: $147 one-time, includes future updates (per their page).
description: Writing and book formatting in one app, for ebooks and print.

name: Scrivener
price_note: $59.99 for macOS or Windows (Literature & Latte pricing page). One licence per platform.
description: Long-form writing app with a binder, corkboard and compile tool for books.

name: Dabble
price_note: $19/month (Writer) or $29/month (Author); $699 lifetime Author access. 14-day free trial.
description: Novel-writing app with plot grid, goals and cloud sync.

name: Novelcrafter
price_note: No free plan. 21-day free trial. See page for plan prices.
description: Planning and writing tool for novelists, with optional AI features.

name: Reedsy Studio
price_note: Core writing and formatting are free. Premium plans start at $4.99/month for extras like outlining and writing stats.
description: Free online book editor that exports ebook and print files.

name: Sudowrite
price_note: Paid plans listed from $10 (see page for billing period). Free trial offered.
description: AI writing assistant for fiction. You stay in control of the text.

name: ProWritingAid
price_note: Free plan gives suggestions on 500 words at a time. Paid Premium plans and lifetime licences are on the pricing page.
description: Grammar and style checker that works inside writing apps and in the browser.

name: Grammarly
price_note: Free plan available; Pro is paid (see page for current price).
description: General grammar and spelling checker.

name: Hemingway Editor
price_note: Editor Plus is $100/year billed annually; desktop app $19.99 (Hemingway pages).
description: Highlights long, hard-to-read sentences so your writing is easier to follow.

name: Vellum
price_note: Vellum Ebooks $199.99, Vellum Press $249.99, one-time. Upgrade between them $69.99 (Vellum store and help). Mac only.
description: Makes polished ebook and print files from a manuscript. Runs on macOS only.

name: Kindle Previewer
price_note: Free desktop app from Amazon.
description: Shows how your ebook will look on Kindle devices before you publish.

name: Calibre
price_note: Free and open source (GPL-3.0).
description: Ebook manager and converter. Handy for checking and converting ebook files.

name: Sigil
price_note: Free and open source (GPL-3.0).
description: EPUB editor for fixing the code of your ebook by hand.

name: Pandoc
price_note: Free and open source (GPL-2.0).
description: Converts between document formats, such as Markdown to EPUB. Command line.

name: Affinity
price_note: Free for individuals (per their page).
description: Design apps for covers and interior graphics.

name: BookBrush
price_note: Free plan exists. Paid plans listed from $8.25/month billed yearly ($99).
description: Makes book mockups, ads and social images.

name: Amazon KDP
price_note: Ebook royalty options of 35% or 70% depending on price and country (KDP royalties page).
description: Amazon's self-publishing platform for ebooks and print.

name: Kobo Writing Life
price_note: Free to publish. Earn up to 70% royalties. No exclusivity (Kobo page).
description: Publish ebooks and audiobooks to Kobo stores.

name: Apple Books for Authors
price_note: 70% royalties on every ebook; no file delivery fees (Apple page).
description: Publish ebooks directly to Apple Books.

name: Google Play Books Partner Center
price_note: 70% revenue split in 60+ countries (Google page).
description: Publish ebooks directly to Google Play Books.

name: Draft2Digital
price_note: One-time $20 activation fee, plus an annual $12 fee if you earn under $100 a year in sales, plus about 10% of retail price per sale (D2D FAQ).
description: Distributes your ebook to many stores from one account.

name: PublishDrive
price_note: One ebook free to selected stores with no subscription or commission. Paid plans for more titles (see page).
description: Distribution to stores and libraries, plus royalty tools.

name: IngramSpark
price_note: Ebook royalty is 85% of net revenue; converting print to ebook costs $0.60/page (IngramSpark pricing page). See page for print fees.
description: Print and ebook distribution into bookstores and libraries.

name: Lulu
price_note: Free to publish. You earn 80% after printing costs (Lulu page).
description: Print on demand with its own store and shop integrations.

name: Bowker Identifiers (ISBN)
price_note: Single ISBN $125; 10 ISBNs $295 (Bowker page, US).
description: Official US source for your own ISBNs.

name: ACX
price_note: Free ACX profile to find a narrator. Narration payment terms are set per title (see ACX).
description: Marketplace to find a narrator and sell on Audible, Amazon and Apple.

name: Publisher Rocket
price_note: $199 one-time lifetime access (Publisher Rocket pricing section).
description: Amazon keyword and category research for book authors.

name: KDSPY
price_note: $79 one-time (price shown on their page, described as a limited offer). 60-day money-back guarantee.
description: Book niche and keyword research for Amazon.

name: Book Bolt
price_note: Entry plan about $9.99/month billed annually. 3-day free trial.
description: Keyword research plus cover and interior design tools for low-content KDP books.

name: BookFunnel
price_note: Paid plans, with the lowest listed at $30/year (BookFunnel pricing page).
description: Delivers ebooks and audiobooks to readers, for reader magnets and ARCs.

name: StoryOrigin
price_note: Upgrade is $100/year per account (StoryOrigin page).
description: Newsletter swaps, reader magnets and promos for authors.

name: Booksprout
price_note: Free plan to start building a review team. Paid plans listed from $9/month. Reviewers are always free.
description: Finds advance readers to review your book.

name: BookBub Partners
price_note: Featured Deals are a flat fee set by price, category and region. BookBub Ads use a CPM auction (BookBub help page).
description: Promotions and ads aimed at BookBub's readers.

name: BookFolio (by the maintainer)
price_note: Free tier: one book and the first 25 newsletter signups. Pro is a paid upgrade; see the buy page for the current price.
description: WordPress theme to sell your books from your own author website. Needs WooCommerce.

name: KDP Toolkit (by the maintainer)
price_note: Free and open source (MIT).
description: Command-line toolkit for Amazon KDP: print-ready interior PDF, cover wrap with spine math, preflight checks, keyword ideas, metadata checks and royalty math.

name: ebook2audiobook
price_note: Free and open source (Apache-2.0). Check the voice and model licences before selling audiobooks.
description: Turns ebooks into audio with local AI voices. Quality and rights depend on the model.

name: audiblez
price_note: Free and open source (MIT). Check the voice model licence before selling audio.
description: Makes audiobooks from EPUB files with a local text-to-speech model.

name: Glim (by the author)
price_note: Free and MIT-licensed per the project's README (https://github.com/NeoPanic/Glim); no paid tier is listed.
description: macOS viewer for EPUB text, PDFs and Markdown drafts; EPUB previews do not preserve publisher CSS or fixed layouts.
